name: Tony Evers
stance: Opposes federal preemption of state AI safeguards.

statements.text: To be clear: if you, your administration, or Congressional Republicans make any attempt to preempt state laws like Wisconsin’s that create basic, common-sense AI safeguards, you will be making kids and families in Wisconsin less safe from dangerous and malicious misuses of AI,
